# Fabrials UI

The Fabrials design system as a shadcn registry: Fabrials' own components, shims that back shadcn primitives with @fabrials/ui, and components from other open-source libraries under permissive licenses, each labelled with its license and origin.
React 19, Tailwind 4, Base UI. MCP target 2026-07-28; WebMCP is a browser proposal, distinct from remote MCP.

## Set up
Namespace: add "registries": { "@fabrials": "https://ui.fabrials.com/r/{name}.json" } to components.json, then npx shadcn@latest add @fabrials/<name>.
- New app: npx shadcn@latest init https://ui.fabrials.com/r/init.json
- Existing app: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/init.json (palette and styles) or https://ui.fabrials.com/r/styles.json (styles only)
- Design principles: https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/design

## Fabrials components
- [Comparison](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/comparison): Show choices side by side and highlight the evidence behind a recommendation.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/comparison.json
- [WebMCP provider](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/webmcp-provider): Give your interface a shared home for tools, state and agent activity.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/webmcp-provider.json
- [Agent-ready form](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/webmcp-form): Semantic forms that people and browser agents can fill together.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/webmcp-form.json
- [Browser support](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/support-badge): Show native support, legacy compatibility or manual mode.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/support-badge.json
- [Action button](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/action-button): A single action with pending, error and duplicate-click handling.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/action-button.json
- [Arguments form](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/arguments-form): Turn a tool schema into a usable form, with a JSON escape hatch.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/arguments-form.json
- [Data explorer](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/data-explorer): Search, filter, sort and select records with one shared state.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/data-explorer.json
- [Date range](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/date-range): Native date fields and an accessible calendar, working in tandem.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/date-range.json
- [Multi-step flow](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/wizard): Guide a shared human-agent workflow through review and completion.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/wizard.json
- [Confirmation](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/confirmation-dialog): Give an action a clear review point before it runs.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/confirmation-dialog.json
- [MCP client](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/mcp-client): Connect to the current protocol, with isolated legacy compatibility.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/mcp-client.json
- [Connection panel](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/connection-panel): An endpoint, an auth method, and a clear connection state.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/connection-panel.json
- [Tool catalog](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/tool-catalog): Make tool discovery readable, searchable and keyboard accessible.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/tool-catalog.json
- [Tool detail](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/tool-detail): A tool description, its arguments, and the action in one place.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/tool-detail.json
- [Result viewer](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/result-view): Readable text, structured content and media, with raw data one click away.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/result-view.json
- [Execution history](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/execution-log): Follow progress, inspect results, and cancel outstanding requests.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/execution-log.json
- [Elicitation](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/elicitation-dialog): Answer the server when a tool needs another piece of information.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/elicitation-dialog.json
- [Resources & prompts](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/resource-explorer): Read resources, resolve templates, and fill reusable prompts.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/resource-explorer.json
- [MCP dashboard](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/mcp-dashboard): A complete working console, composed from the registry.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/mcp-dashboard.json
- [Server connector](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/server-connector): An optional Node bridge for private credentials and endpoints without CORS.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/server-connector.json

## From other libraries
### Kibo UI (MIT, community) https://www.kibo-ui.com
- [Contribution Graph](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/kibo-contribution-graph): A GitHub-style contribution graph component that displays activity levels over time.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/kibo-contribution-graph.json
- [Dropzone](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/kibo-dropzone): Allows users to drag-and-drop files into a container to upload or process them.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/kibo-dropzone.json
- [Kanban](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/kibo-kanban): A kanban board is a visual tool that helps you manage and visualize your work. It is a board with columns, and each column represents a status, e.g. "Backlog", "In Progress", "Done".
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/kibo-kanban.json
- [Rating](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/kibo-rating): A star rating component with keyboard navigation and hover effects.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/kibo-rating.json

### Magic UI (MIT, community) https://magicui.design
- [Animated List](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/magicui-animated-list): A list that animates each item in sequence with a delay. Used to showcase notifications or events on your landing page.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/magicui-animated-list.json
- [Dot Pattern](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/magicui-dot-pattern): A background dot pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/magicui-dot-pattern.json
- [File Tree](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/magicui-file-tree): A component used to showcase the folder and file structure of a directory.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/magicui-file-tree.json
- [Marquee](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/magicui-marquee): An infinite scrolling component that can be used to display text, images, or videos.
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/magicui-marquee.json
- [Terminal](https://ui.fabrials.com/docs/magicui-terminal): A terminal component
  Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.fabrials.com/r/magicui-terminal.json
